title: Quiet Please
studio_context: A drum feature for Rich with Dorsey; later on the compilation That Sentimental Gentleman. Filmed again as Not So Quiet Please.

drum_performances.name: Buddy Rich
drum_performances.why_it_matters: A swing-era feature: Fidyk's example of his early tom and snare soloing.

notable_moments.description: Tom and snare soloing with the Dorsey band (Fidyk).

evidence.note: Fidyk names it, from That Sentimental Gentleman (1940); Fischer transcribed the filmed Not So Quiet Please. No discography entry was read.
